name: KinFlo client provisioning execution manifest

providerBoundary.notes: This manifest defines the dry-run execution order for client website provisioning orders. It does not create tenants, create sites, grant memberships, invite users, send email, activate billing, attach domains, publish content, write leads, call providers, import generated API, or execute hosted activation.

blockedUntil: Hosted Convex deployment is approved, provisioned, and owned by Vambah.
CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT and VITE_CONVEX_URL are configured outside committed source.
Generated Convex API codegen is approved, reviewed, and import-gated.
Read-only hosted smokes pass for viewer, roles, plan catalog, starter templates, launch blueprints, admin permission presets, provisioning orders, and public renderer.
Mutation smoke order is approved with cleanup and rollback owner.
Invitation delivery policy is approved before any email is sent.
Domain, storage, billing, AI, SMS, and email provider boundaries are reviewed before provider writes.

dryRunSteps.rollback: Keep public renderer on fixtures and do not attach domains until provenance and renderer smoke pass.

site, member, custom-domain, and campaign limits are understood
tenant creation is blocked until entitlement review passes
dryRunSteps.rollback: Keep order in blocked_provider_gate status and do not create a tenant.
